search.purpose: The query and its placeholder in the 52 pt search bar.

tile-name.purpose: The selected item's name on the tile.

row-title.purpose: Each row's name; actions and apps in ⌘K.

key-primary.purpose: What ⏎ does, on the tile, in label color (red in Force Quit's confirmation).

key-secondary.purpose: Actions, Back, Cancel, in quiet gray.

return-mark.purpose: The ↩ at the end of the selected row, in the Key color.

detail.purpose: Folders after row names; the tile's folder and kind lines.

tag.purpose: "running" at the end of a running app's row.

key-cap.purpose: The glyph inside a key cap (↩, ⌘, K, esc), in the Key color.

shadows.name: panel-system
shadows.purpose: The panel's only shadow. Nothing inside the panel casts one.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: The panel appears, resizes and disappears in one frame, with no animation (animationBehavior = .none).

components.name: Panel

components.html: Search

narrative.overview:
The panel answers one question before you press ⏎: what will it act on? A tile under the search bar shows the selected item large, with its icon, name, folder and kind, and the keys for ⏎ and ⌘K on its right. The list under it is compact. In ⌘K and Open With… the item stays on the tile while the list becomes its actions or apps, and the tile's first key names the selected one.

Everything else is quiet. The panel is the system window color, the tile and the selection are low-opacity fills of the label color, and nothing is filled with the accent color. Color appears only where it means something: red for Force Quit waiting for its second ⏎, orange for a config problem. Type is SF at fixed point sizes, icons are the system's own app and file icons and SF Symbols. The panel never animates, blurs or goes translucent; it appears in one frame and stays still.

Light and dark follow the system. Each custom color is a light/dark pair in `Sources/Launcher/Palette.swift`; every other color is an AppKit semantic color (`windowBackgroundColor`, `labelColor`, `placeholderTextColor`, the separator).
keyCharacteristics: A 92 pt tile that always shows what ⏎ acts on, with its keys spelled out.
Compact 32 pt rows on one line: icon, name, folder.
Quiet fills (3.5–4.5 % tile, 7–10 % selection) instead of an accent bar.
The selected row ends in ↩, so the selection never relies on its fill.
Color only for meaning: red for danger, orange for a problem.
Opaque, still, fixed geometry: no motion, no blur, no layout shift while typing.

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the panel is filled or tinted with the accent color or any brand hue. The selection is a gray fill plus ↩.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Red and orange appear only for Force Quit's confirmation and config problems. A new hue needs a new meaning first.

rules.name: The Fill-Is-Not-Enough Rule
rules.body: A low-contrast fill never carries state alone: the selected row ends in ↩ and the tile names the item.

rules.name: The 11 pt Floor Rule
rules.body: No text is smaller than 11 pt.

rules.name: The Cut-in-the-Middle Rule
rules.body: Names and folders that don't fit truncate in the middle, so both the start and the extension stay visible (`Quarterly_Bud…Review.pdf`).

rules.name: The One-Baseline Rule
rules.body: Everything on a row (name, folder, "running", ↩) sits on the name's baseline.

rules.name: The Flat-Inside Rule
rules.body: Only the panel casts a shadow, and it is the system's. Nothing inside the panel is lifted.

dos: **Do** show what ⏎ acts on in the tile, with the ⏎ key's words in semibold label color.
**Do** end the selected row in ↩, and keep the selection a quiet fill (black 7 % light, white 10 % dark) with 7 pt corners, inset 8 pt.
**Do** use the system semantic colors for surfaces and text, and Palette's quiet gray (#666666 / #A1A1A1) for everything secondary.
**Do** keep every element on the shared grid: icons at 18 pt, text at 48 pt, 18 pt from the right.
**Do** keep the panel's height fixed at 423 pt with results, however many rows there are.
**Do** use SF Symbols in regular weight, in quiet gray, for anything that has no app or file icon.
**Do** check text and meaningful symbols against WCAG AA in light and dark, on the selection, its darkest background.
donts: **Don't** fill the selection, a key or anything else with the accent color or a solid color bar.
**Don't** use red or orange except for Force Quit's confirmation and config problems.
**Don't** animate, fade, slide or blur anything; the panel appears and disappears in one frame.
**Don't** use materials, vibrancy, translucency or Liquid Glass; the panel is opaque.
**Don't** set text below 11 pt, or use uppercase labels or letter-spacing for hierarchy.
**Don't** hide what ⏎ does in a footer or leave it unsaid.
